**Please do not attach personal documents.** Issues are public. If a problem only shows with a certain file, try to reproduce it with a harmless one, or describe the file: where it came from (Word, a scanner, a website form…), how many pages, in which language.

"Report a problem…" in LocalPDF fills in the first five lines for you. It is in the menu of the arrow next to "Download", and on the start screen.
